title: Construct explicit polynomial-in-sector Jacobi dispersion and critical-norm single-mode bounds
statement: For every real A>=1, H_A has zero diagonal and bonds c_n/2,c_n=(A^2+n(n+1))/(sqrt(A^2+n^2)*sqrt(A^2+(n+1)^2)). The complete Root proof gives ||exp(it H_A)||ell1->ellinfinity<=2^1000*(1+A)^8*(1+|t|)^(-1/3) for every realt. Moment bounds give M1=sum(1+|n|)(1-c_n)<=(pi+1)/2,M2<=pi/A+2+pi*A/4 and sum(1-c_n)>=1/(12A). Set v_n=1-c_n^2,Q_n=product_(j=n)^infinity c_j,phi_plus=z^n*g_n/Q_n. The exact future-directed Volterra recurrence g_n=1+sum_(m>n)v_m*(z^2+...+z^(2(m-n)))*g_(m+1), with Q_n^-1<8,n>=-1, yields Wiener norms||g_n||A<=exp(8),theta-derivatives<=64exp(16)*(1+A) by ordered-product factorial summation. Reflection supplies proper-side left Jost bounds. Positive monotone edge flux gives |W(+1)|,|W(-1)|>=1/(12A). Derivative bound<=C0*(1+A),C0=2^100, plus unitarity away from edges gives global |W|>=2^-110*(1+A)^-2. Quantitative H1-to-Wiener inversion gives ||1/W||A and scattering coefficients <=C*(1+A)^5. The cited EHT1506.06555v2 Section3 Jost/scattering kernel and proper-half-line relations then have amplitude Wiener norms polynomial uniformly in BOTH lattice indices; finite-interval van-der-Corput with arbitrary linear phase gives the stated explicit dispersion bound. For one native-velocity Fourier mode(xi,n0),both polarisations/staticphase obey F_-1(U_s w)<=C*(1+|xi|)^8*[1+log(2+tau)]*(1+tau)^(-1/3)*|w_hat(xi,n0)|,tau=2pi*s*|a_actual.xi|. This uses a full-ladder split J=ceil((1+tau)^(2/3)), the uniform kernel and ell2 tail, and is uniform in starting ladder index. It closes the formerly operator-dependent unweighted single-sector constant; the prior weighted t^-4/3 estimate is not claimed uniform here. Tiny/zero calibrated coupling, noncommuting composition/high-to-low re-entry, cumulative nonlinear H3 and the full fixed-actuator controller remain UNRESOLVED. Complete analytic proof is supplied; no new code/PDE execution, novelty or practical claim.
